title: SuiteResult
description: What a suite run writes to <out_dir>/suite.json. This is the file CI, an optimizer, the refinement loop and the dashboard all poll, which is why it has a schema of its own (docs/DECISIONS.md D-25). Field sets are versioned once: 1.0 is written at suite end by a single-round run; 1.1 adds the refinement-loop fields and the live-progress fields together. Evolution is additive, so a 1.0 document still validates here.

status.description: 1.1. Absent in a 1.0 document. `aborted` means the run stopped early -- a control scenario failed, or tampering was detected.

started_at.description: ISO-8601. Empty string when the suite selected no scenarios.

finished_at.description: Null while `status` is `running`. A timing field; never read by decision logic.

planned.description: 1.1. Scenario ids the run intends to execute, in order, known before the first one starts.

current.description: 1.1. The scenario executing right now, or null when none is.

round.description: 1.1. Which refinement round produced this document. 1 for a single-round run.

rounds_planned.description: 1.1. `max_rounds`, so a consumer can render progress before the loop ends.

coverage.description: Fault types that actually fired, and how often. This namespace is fault kinds and nothing else (D-25) -- judge metrics are top-level fields.

worst.description: The first few failing scenario ids, for a one-line CI summary.

tasks_written.description: AGENT_TASK.md paths. This is the product: hand these to a coding agent.

rounds.description: 1.1. One entry per completed refinement round.

outcomes.description: Scenario id to its classification in this round.

flipped.description: 1.1. Scenarios that went from failing to passing, and when. A flip whose plan or scenario file changed is NOT here -- it is a regression (docs/05 section 9).

regressions.description: 1.1. Human-readable lines. Covers both a scenario that went from passing to failing and a scenario that 'passed' only after being modified.

judge_disagreement_rate.description: Fraction of judged runs where the model's classification contradicted the probes. The probes won; a high rate means the probes or the judge prompt need work (docs/05 section 7).

judge_latency_ms_total.description: Total time spent in judge calls, so nobody is surprised by suite wall-time (docs/05 section 10).

wall_ms.description: 1.1. Total wall time across every round. A timing field.

tamper.description: 1.1. The integrity record. A coding agent that 'fixes' a failure by weakening the scenario is the failure mode this exists to catch, and it is not hypothetical (docs/05 section 9).

probes_sha256.description: Hash of the installed probe module's source, taken each round.

probes_changed.description: True when the probe module's hash changed mid-loop.

control_failed.description: The id of a control scenario that failed, which aborts the loop.

modified.description: Scenario ids whose plan hash, file hash or must_not list changed between rounds.

scenarios.description: Scenario id to its integrity hashes, as of the latest round.
